items.title: Approve minutes of the regular meeting of September 25, 2026
Discuss Security with Harris County Sheriff’s Office
Adopt Order Setting Tax Rate and Levying Tax Rate
Tax Assessor and Collector’s Report, including approval of payment of bills
Bookkeeper’s Report, including approval of Investment Report and payment of bills
Operator’s Report and authorize termination of service to delinquent accounts
Engineer’s Report, including authorization of utility commitment letters, payment of pay estimates and approval of change orders, and such other related matters
Ratify approval of the Agreement between Harris County and Weston MUD Relating to Joint Elections to be held on November 3, 2026; And such other matters as may properly come before it
